note: Static tool manifest for the selection-list-mcp gateway. The gateway (packages/mcp-gateway) derives these at runtime from the OpenAPI spec (services/selection-list-service/openapi.yaml) + deploy/helm/fuzefront/files/mcp-tools-selection-lists.overrides.yaml; this file is the checked-in record that CI and the mcp-maintainer agent use to detect drift. Regenerate by running the gateway locally and capturing GET /tools.json, or update manually when the spec changes. `mutates` is the load-bearing field — a wrong value is a safety defect, not a cosmetic one. This gateway ships dark (selectionListService.enabled AND selectionListsMcp.enabled both required). Override keys in the overrides file must be exact operationIds (forkSelectionList is a reversible write); the gateway refuses to boot on an unknown key and packages/mcp-gateway/test/overrides-conformance.test.ts asserts tool names + mutates against this file. `resolveSelectionListItems` is POST-but-read-only by the spec's explicit design decision; mutates stays false.

tools.name: listSelectionLists
tools.description: [READ-ONLY] List selection lists in the caller's organization (GET /v1/selection-lists). Cursor-paginated. With include_shared=true also returns shared org/platform lists readable through visibility.

locale.description: Preferred locale for resolved text in each row.

key.description: Exact-match filter on the org-unique list key. With include_shared=true returns the effective list for that key.

include_shared.description: Also return lists readable through visibility (org/platform). Requires SelectionListCatalog:read_shared.

visibility.description: Filter to only lists with this visibility.

tools.name: createSelectionList
tools.description: [WRITE] Create a selection list (POST /v1/selection-lists). Server mints the id. key must be org-unique. visibility defaults to private; platform requires publish_platform in the platform organization.

key.description: Org-unique, stable slug (e.g. countries). Immutable after create.

source_locale.description: The authoritative locale for name/description. Defaults to the org's primary locale.

name.description: List name in source_locale. Seeds the source translation.

visibility.description: Who may read without an instance grant. platform requires publish_platform in the platform org.

tools.name: getSelectionList
tools.description: [READ-ONLY] Get one selection list (GET /v1/selection-lists/{listId}). Returns 404 — never 403 — when the caller cannot read it. Readable through an instance grant or shared read for org/platform lists.

tools.name: updateSelectionList
tools.description: [WRITE] Partial update of a selection list (PATCH /v1/selection-lists/{listId}). Omitted fields are left untouched. Changing visibility requires manage_access; promoting to platform requires publish_platform. A platform list can never be demoted.

body.description: Fields to update. At least one field required.

status.description: Setting archived requires delete permission in addition to update.

visibility.description: Requires manage_access. platform is one-way — a platform list cannot be demoted (409 visibility_locked).

tools.name: deleteSelectionList
tools.description: [WRITE — IRREVERSIBLE WHEN purge=true] Archive (default) or purge a selection list (DELETE /v1/selection-lists/{listId}). Archive is reversible; purge permanently destroys the list, all items, translations and grants, and breaks every consumer reference.

purge.description: When true, permanently deletes instead of archiving. IRREVERSIBLE.

tools.name: archiveSelectionList
tools.description: [WRITE — reversible] Archive a selection list (POST /v1/selection-lists/{listId}/archive). Sets status=archived. Idempotent. Reversible via PATCH { status: active }.

tools.name: forkSelectionList
tools.description: [WRITE] Fork a common list into the caller's organization (POST /v1/selection-lists/{listId}/fork). Copies a platform list as an editable list in the caller's org, keeping the same key. Idempotent per (org, source) — returns the existing fork on a second call. Subject to org_lists, user_lists and list_items quotas. Reversible by archiving the fork (reverts the org to the common list); purging it is the separate irreversible DELETE.

listId.description: The front_sl_-prefixed id of the platform list to fork.

body.description: Optional fork settings. Omit for defaults.

visibility.description: Visibility of the fork. org (default) makes it the org's version; private keeps it a draft. Cannot be platform.

tools.name: listSelectionListItems
tools.description: [READ-ONLY] List the items of a selection list (GET /v1/selection-lists/{listId}/items). Cursor-paginated, ordered by sort_order. Defaults to status=active.

tools.name: createSelectionListItem
tools.description: [WRITE] Add an item to a selection list (POST /v1/selection-lists/{listId}/items). Server mints the id. code must be unique within the list (immutable after create). label seeds the source_locale translation.

code.description: Unique, immutable item code within this list.

label.description: Item label in the list's source_locale.

description.description: Optional helper text in the list's source_locale.

sort_order.description: Explicit position. Omit to append at max(sort_order) + 100.

tools.name: reorderSelectionListItems
tools.description: [WRITE] Set the order of every item in a list (PUT /v1/selection-lists/{listId}/items/reorder). item_ids must contain every non-archived item exactly once. Atomic whole-collection replace.

item_ids.description: Every non-archived item id, in the desired display order.

tools.name: updateSelectionListItem
tools.description: [WRITE] Partial update of an item (PATCH /v1/selection-lists/{listId}/items/{itemId}). code is immutable and rejected by additionalProperties:false. Omitted fields are left untouched.

body.description: Fields to update. At least one required.

description.description: New helper text; null clears it.

tools.name: deleteSelectionListItem
tools.description: [WRITE — IRREVERSIBLE WHEN purge=true] Archive (default) or purge an item (DELETE /v1/selection-lists/{listId}/items/{itemId}). Archived items keep resolving. Purge is irreversible and turns every stored reference into missing.

purge.description: When true, permanently deletes instead of archiving. IRREVERSIBLE.

tools.name: archiveSelectionListItem
tools.description: [WRITE — reversible] Archive an item (POST /v1/selection-lists/{listId}/items/{itemId}/archive). Sets status=archived. Idempotent. Archived items keep their sort_order and keep resolving.

tools.name: listSelectionListTranslations
tools.description: [READ-ONLY] List translated locales for a selection list (GET /v1/selection-lists/{listId}/translations). Returns one status entry per locale that has a list-level translation (source_locale excluded). Unbounded (max 11 locales).

tools.name: upsertSelectionListTranslation
tools.description: [WRITE] Create or replace a list's translation for one locale (PUT /v1/selection-lists/{listId}/translations/{locale}). Idempotent. Sets is_machine=false and stamps source_hash — protects the translation from autofill overwrites.

tools.name: deleteSelectionListTranslation
tools.description: [WRITE — IRREVERSIBLE] Remove a list's translation for one locale (DELETE /v1/selection-lists/{listId}/translations/{locale}). The source_locale cannot be deleted. Idempotent (deleting a non-existent translation returns 204).

locale.description: Target locale. Cannot be the list's source_locale.

tools.name: autofillSelectionListTranslations
tools.description: [WRITE] Machine-translate every missing or stale translation for one locale (POST /v1/selection-lists/{listId}/translations/{locale}/autofill). Human translations (is_machine=false) are never overwritten. Synchronous.

locale.description: Target locale. Must differ from source_locale.

overwrite_machine.description: Also refresh existing machine-translated rows. Never touches is_machine=false rows.

item_ids.description: Restrict to these items. Omit to cover the list and all non-archived items.

tools.name: listSelectionListItemTranslations
tools.description: [READ-ONLY] List all translated locales for one item (GET /v1/selection-lists/{listId}/items/{itemId}/translations). One status entry per locale with a translation (source_locale excluded). Unbounded (max 11 locales).

tools.name: upsertSelectionListItemTranslation
tools.description: [WRITE] Create or replace an item's translation for one locale (PUT /v1/selection-lists/{listId}/items/{itemId}/translations/{locale}). Idempotent. Sets is_machine=false and stamps source_hash.

description.description: Translated helper text; null clears it.

tools.name: deleteSelectionListItemTranslation
tools.description: [WRITE — IRREVERSIBLE] Remove an item's translation for one locale (DELETE /v1/selection-lists/{listId}/items/{itemId}/translations/{locale}). The source_locale cannot be deleted. Idempotent.

locale.description: Target locale. Cannot be the list's source_locale.

tools.name: listSelectionListAccess
tools.description: [READ-ONLY] List the access grants on a selection list (GET /v1/selection-lists/{listId}/access). Cursor-paginated. Requires manage_access (list-owner only).

tools.name: setSelectionListAccess
tools.description: [WRITE] Grant or change a user's role on a selection list (PUT /v1/selection-lists/{listId}/access/{userId}). Idempotent upsert. Roles do not stack — a user holds exactly one. Demoting the last list-owner is refused (409).

userId.description: The usr_-prefixed id of the user to grant.

tools.name: revokeSelectionListAccess
tools.description: [WRITE — IRREVERSIBLE] Revoke a user's access to a selection list (DELETE /v1/selection-lists/{listId}/access/{userId}). Idempotent (revoking a non-existent grant returns 204). Revoking the last list-owner is refused (409). A new grant must be issued to restore access — no unrevoke operation.

userId.description: The usr_-prefixed id of the user whose grant to revoke.

tools.name: getSelectionListQuota
tools.description: [READ-ONLY] Get quota usage and ceilings for the caller's organization (GET /v1/selection-lists/quota). Returns four quota scopes (org_lists, user_lists, list_items, list_locales). Requires read_quota (admin only).

tools.name: resolveSelectionListItems
tools.description: [READ-ONLY] Bulk-resolve item ids to their labels (POST /v1/resolve). POST because the id batch does not fit a URL — the operation is read-only and cacheable. Returns labels, locale, status for each resolved id, plus the set of missing ids. Archived items resolve normally; only purged ids land in missing.

ids.description: Item ids to resolve. Bounded at 500 per call.
